what: On the left end of a white pill button sit a same-color round blob and a sky-blue arrow chip — on hover the blob stretches to the button’s end over .5s ease, covering it in sky blue, the chip moves .5rem right, and the text turns white (all three .5s ease). On release it returns the same way

options.--fx-dur: How long chunks grow and chips travel (via style), default .5s — 0s switches instantly
options.--fx-chip-x: Space left of the chip, default 1.95em
options.--fx-ease: Block and chip curve (via style), default ease

note: The blue button type sets --fx-bg as the accent, --fx-fill as white, --fx-chip as navy, and --fx-ink-on as dark ink. To make the blob 40% wide like the symptom pill, use --fx-blob: 40%

from.where: shared.css .btn01 (original common.css .btn01 — ::after 7.4rem white blob → on hover width 100% and #77afd9, ::before 3.6×2.4rem chip left 3.1 → 3.6rem, a, a::before and a::after all transition all .5s ease) · .mk-pills a (original .concerns_btn a — ::after 40% → 100% and #395ca3)
